post_title: What will India's All-India CPI inflation rate (year-on-year) for October 2026 be?

question.title: What will India's All-India CPI inflation rate (year-on-year) for October 2026 be?
question.description:
India's CPI is published monthly by MoSPI's National Statistical Office (series rebased to 2024=100). Each release reports the year-on-year rate for the combined (rural + urban) General index, plus rural, urban and food (CFPI) rates. The October 2026 release is scheduled for 12 November 2026 at 16:00 IST, as stated in the September 2026 release (https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2322244&reg=3&lang=1).

Inflation has accelerated through 2026: the combined year-on-year rate was 2.74% in January, 4.38% in June, 4.45% in July, 4.83% in August and 5.54% (provisional) in September 2026 — a 21-month high and just below the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit (target 4%, band 2-6%). September's food inflation (CFPI) was 7.74% (rural 8.06%, urban 7.18%), with rural headline inflation at 6.08% — already above 6% — and urban at 4.88%. Item-level pressures are sharp and concentrated: onion +108.09%, silver jewellery +87.80%, ginger +62.85%, garlic +54.62%, lemon +36.41%, personal care +13.75%, restaurants and accommodation +9.36%. Partly offsetting: potato -11.50%, tomato -8.62%, motor vehicles -4.51%.

Two opposing forces dominate the October reading. First, momentum and base effects: September 2025 inflation was only 1.54%, so the year-earlier base remains low, and y/y rates rise mechanically even if month-on-month price gains moderate. Second, whether the onion/silver-led spike extends or fades.

Policy backdrop: the RBI raised its policy rate in October 2026 and projects CPI inflation of 5.2% for FY2026-27, with Q3 FY27 (October-December) at 6.0% and Q4 at 5.7%. SBI Research has projected inflation above 6.5% in October-November 2026. A combined print above 6% would take headline inflation outside the RBI's tolerance band. For scale: the combined index stood at 109.49 in September 2026 versus 103.74 in September 2025.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the year-on-year inflation rate for India's All-India Consumer Price Index (CPI), General index, combined (rural + urban), base 2024=100, for the month of October 2026, as published by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) / National Statistical Office in its press release "Consumer Price Index on Base 2024=100 for October 2026". That release is scheduled for 12 November 2026 at 16:00 IST (10:30 UTC), or the next working day if 12 November 2026 is a holiday, and is linked from MoSPI's release calendar at https://mospi.gov.in/release-calendar. Report the headline combined figure exactly as published, in percent (e.g., a release stating 6.42% resolves as 6.42). The first published, provisional figure is used; any later revision of that month's rate does not change the resolution. If MoSPI's release is delayed, resolution waits for its publication; if the figure cannot be read from MoSPI's own release, the value as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.
